# braintrust_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages a project-scoped MCP server connection in Braintrust.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the MCP server, unique within the project.
- `project_id` (String) Project that uses this MCP server.
- `url` (String) URL of the MCP server endpoint.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the MCP server.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of deletion, or null while active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the MCP server.
- `user_id` (String) User who created the MCP server.
